# Bacco Adega CRM

> CRM exclusivo para vinícolas, com atendimento por WhatsApp e agentes de IA. Capta e converte três públicos da vinícola: clientes B2B (restaurantes, empórios, distribuidores), interessados em enoturismo (visitas e degustações) e consumidores de vinho. Produto da Bacco Sistemas.

Key facts:
- Category: vertical CRM for wineries / WhatsApp customer platform with AI agents
- Audiences: winery B2B customers, wine tourism leads, wine consumers — each with its own sales pipeline
- AI: per-tenant agents that answer, qualify and move leads; they recommend only wines that exist in the catalog and never promise a visit slot (booking is confirmed by the team)
- WhatsApp: via WAHA, with anti-ban throttling, media and opt-out detection
- Catalog: wine products with vintage, grape and volume in the product name
- Compliance: multi-tenant Postgres RLS, LGPD by design (redact, data requests, anonymization), append-only audit log
- Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime + Storage), Vercel AI SDK, WAHA
- License: built on DeskcommCRM (MIT), https://github.com/melgarafael/DeskcommCRM
